summary: ArdentSupply dedicated autoscaler collapsed to zero capacity during peak window causing degraded fallbacks, 429s and duplicate completions
description: Issue summary: During a scheduled traffic spike on 2026-03-12 ~14:05 PDT the Dedicated autoscaler managing ArdentSupply's reserved GPU pool performed a metadata reconciliation that incorrectly interpreted a partially-applied etcd compaction as an intent to scale to zero. Impact: customer observed elevated 429s, a surge in tail latency as requests fell back to CPU-quantized variants, and a small subset of requests produced duplicate short completions due to replay/ack race during failover. The incident also triggered unexpected billing activity (double-count at route-level) for ~27 minutes before mitigation. Environment: dedicated GPU pool (tier: reserved-4xA10), private control plane with VPC peering to us-west, autoscaler v2.14.6, etcd cluster v3.5.9.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate partial etcd compaction while a concurrent autoscaler reconciliation is in-flight
Trigger a controlled burst of routed requests that exceed pool headroom (sustained qps + large prompt sizes)
Observe autoscaler reconcile logs for decisions to scale and any node-pool shrink events
Confirm fallbacks: requests routed to fallback model variants and billing counters increment twice when route mirroring is enabled
timeline_summary: 14:02 PDT — ArdentSupply begins scheduled marketing surge; QPS spikes ~3x over baseline
14:04 PDT — etcd compaction cron job starts on control-plane; one controller reports partial write set
14:05 PDT — autoscaler reconcile reads compacted index and treats missing metadata as explicit desired_count=0; issues scale-down
14:06–14:22 PDT — pool reduced to zero; routing layer triggers fallback to CPU-quantized variants and request mirroring causes duplicate accounting
14:23 PDT — SRE detects anomaly via pool-size alert and manually re-applies last-known-good scaling policy; nodes re-provision
14:31 PDT — steady state restored; customers routed back to GPU pool; billing counters reconciled and credits applied
logs_excerpt: [autoscaler] 2026-03-12T21:05:12Z reconcile() read: desired_count not found; defaulting to 0
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: autoscaler bug misinterpreting absent desired_count as an explicit zero (race with etcd compaction)
Confirmed by reproducer: running compaction while reconcile is in-flight returns an RPC error path that resolved to a zero sentinel in v2.14.6
Observed condition was rare and timing-dependent; majority of reconciles unaffected in canaries
Routing layer mirrors enabled for ArdentSupply amplified billing exposure because mirrored requests were charged separately before dedup window applied
mitigations_taken: Immediate: manual re-apply of last-known-good autoscaler state to reserved pool (Diego Alvarez) — restored capacity at 14:23 PDT
Short-term: disabled etcd compaction window for dedicated control plane deployments while autoscaler reconciles are scheduled
Billing: provisional credit applied to ArdentSupply account for duplicated charges; finance ticket open to finalize adjustment
Customer comms: initial incident notification sent 14:28 PDT; follow-up conference call scheduled
resolution_notes: Root cause: a race between control-plane etcd compaction and autoscaler reconcile logic where a failed metadata read was interpreted as desired_count=0. Permanent fix deployed to autoscaler (v2.14.7) that treats absent keys as transient errors and retries with backoff; guard added to never scale below configured min_capacity for dedicated pools. Routing mirror charging now marks mirrored requests as non-billable until deduplication confirms unique completion. Post-incident actions: expanded e2e chaos test that includes compaction timing scenarios, updated runbook to pause compaction during high-volume windows, and added a billing reconciliation job to catch mirrored-charge anomalies within 10 minutes. Final billing credit: $12,450 applied to ArdentSupply account. Incident declared resolved 2026-03-14 after verification and customer sign-off.
post_incident_action_items: ENG-1974: Autoscaler - implement robust absent-key handling and retry semantics (merged)
ENG-1989: Autoscaler - enforce min_capacity guard for dedicated pools (deployed v2.14.7)
OPS-2230: Control plane compaction scheduling - avoid compaction windows during business-critical reconclies
SRE-2101: Add chaos test variant for etcd compaction + reconcile race
BILLING-403: Mirror-route deduplication audit and reconcile job (10-minute SLA)
